tokens.usage: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `primary` (one step darker in light themes, lighter in dark). More contrast: brand 900 / brand 200.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Alias. Text and icons on `primary` fills (white in light themes, brand 950 in dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary button fill; hover fill for outline and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Hover state of `secondary`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The keyboard-highlighted item in a list: Menu items, Combobox and TimePicker options, the Sidebar's current page. In light the same zinc-100 as `secondary` (about 1.1:1 on `surface`); in dark it shares `secondary`'s zinc-700 (1.7:1 on `surface`, 1.4:1 on `surface-overlay`), with no bar by default (`highlight-indicator`). Text on it keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill while a row, tab, day or page button is held down (`:active`): one step past its hover. `text` keeps 7:1+ on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alias. Card, panel and bar background (white light, zinc-900 dark). The page behind them is `surface-page`.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Alias. The page itself: the <html> and <body> background, and a data-mode or data-theme section's. White in light, as `surface`; in dark zinc-950, a step below the zinc-900 cards, panels and bars on it, so they and every control (fields, buttons, SegmentedControl's track) sit lighter than the page.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary panels, sidebars, table headers, filled Cards and wells: recessed, so a step below `surface` in both modes (zinc-50 under white in light, zinc-950 under zinc-900 in dark). A recess, so never the fill of something you press: controls use `surface-control`.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill of a control that is its own surface rather than a field: SegmentedControl's track, FileUpload's drop zone. zinc-50 in light, as `surface-muted`; in dark a step above the zinc-950 page (zinc-900), so a control is never darker than the surface it sits on.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. A row or item on `surface` under the pointer, a selected row, a striped row (List, Table, InlineEdit): a step off `surface` in every theme (zinc-100 light, the same as `highlight`; zinc-800 dark). Grey text on it reads `text-muted-shaded`.

tokens.name: surface-hover-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. A List or InlineEdit row under the pointer or selected on a raised or floating surface (an elevated Card, a Popover, Dialog or Drawer): zinc-100 in light; in dark a step above zinc-800, halfway to zinc-700, where muted text keeps 4.5:1. Grey text on it reads `text-muted-shaded`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. A raised card (Card `elevated`). One step up from `surface` in dark, where a shadow doesn't show.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Alias. Anything in the top layer: Menu, Popover, Dialog, Drawer, Toast and the Combobox, DatePicker and TimePicker lists.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Alias. Background of text inputs, selects and other form fields: white in light, zinc-800 in dark, a fill that sets a field apart from the page and cards around it.

tokens.name: field-readonly
tokens.usage: Alias. Background of a read-only or disabled form field: a step flatter than `field` (zinc-50 in light, zinc-900 in dark), so it reads as not editable while its `field-border` still outlines it.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Alias. The text, icon and mark of anything disabled, in place of fading it: the same neutral in every brand, so a disabled primary, danger or brand control reads as off, never as a faint version of itself. At least 3:1 on `disabled-surface` and the surfaces (4.5:1 with more contrast).

tokens.name: disabled-surface
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill of a disabled control that has one (a checked box, a switch's track, a slider's fill, the selected segment): a neutral a step off the page, whatever its color when on.

tokens.name: disabled-border
tokens.usage: Alias. The edge of a disabled control: a box, a track, a field's border.

tokens.name: highlight-indicator
tokens.usage: The 2px bar at the start of the highlighted item in a dropdown list: Menu items, and Combobox, Select, TimePicker, MentionInput and CommandPalette options. By default it is the same color as `highlight` in every theme (change both together), so no bar shows and the grey fill alone marks the item: under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks, a deliberate design choice, as with `field-border`. The item is also the one the screen reader names and the one Enter picks. More contrast (`data-contrast="more"` or the system setting) turns the bar `text`-dark, 3:1+ on `highlight`, and forced colors outline the item in `Highlight`.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Alias. Border of form fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, the pickers, Checkbox, Radio, PinInput): a soft line, zinc-300 in light and zinc-700 in dark, a step lighter than the zinc-800 field. It is under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary, a deliberate design choice: the field also shows by its label above it, and in dark by its zinc-800 fill, hover and focus are stronger, and more contrast (`data-contrast="more"` or the system setting) brings back a 3:1+ border. Other controls' edges use `border-control`.

tokens.name: field-border-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Field border on hover: the resting `field-border` one gray step stronger (zinc-400 in light, zinc-600 in dark), so the field answers the pointer without taking the accent, which stays for focus.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Alias. The 3:1 edge of a control that isn't a text or choice field: Slider's track, Switch's track, Progress and Meter's track edge, Carousel's dots, ColorPicker's swatch edge, Stepper's ring and line, Rating's empty stars, SegmentedControl, Kbd, Splitter, ScrollArea's thumb and Avatar's offline dot. 3:1+ against `surface` in every theme (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: border-control-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. `border-control` on hover, one step stronger (Switch's track).

tokens.name: field-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill of a button inside a field under the pointer (a calendar or clock button, Input's icon action, NumberInput's steppers, the country button): `secondary` in light, zinc-700 in dark, a step past the zinc-800 field.

tokens.name: field-pressed
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill of a button inside a field while it's held down, one step past `field-hover` (zinc-200 in light, zinc-600 in dark; text keeps 4.5:1 on it).

tokens.name: field-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. `field` on a raised or floating surface (Dialog, Drawer, Popover, an elevated Card, a bg-surface-raised or bg-surface-overlay panel), which set `--field` to it: white in light; in dark a step above the zinc-800 overlay (#333338, as `surface-hover-raised`), so a field in a dialog still stands out from it instead of matching it. `field-hover` and `field-pressed` already sit a step past it.

tokens.name: field-border-invalid
tokens.usage: Alias. An invalid field's border: `danger` (red 600), 3:1+ on `field` and `surface`. Its own alias so a theme whose field fill is lighter can take a lighter red.

tokens.name: field-action
tokens.usage: Alias. A text action inside a field (Input's "Apply"): `primary`, which keeps 4.5:1 on the field. Its own alias so a brand whose primary falls short on the field can take a lighter shade.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Alias. Placeholder text in form fields, and the other muted text inside a field: a prefix or suffix, a character count, the Caps Lock hint (4.5:1+ on `field` and `field-readonly`). Placeholders are hints, never labels.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Alias. The dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers (zinc-900 at 50% in light themes, zinc-950 at 70% in dark).

tokens.name: picture-edge
tokens.usage: Alias. A hairline just inside a photo's edge (Image, Avatar), so a picture with a white or black background keeps its shape on a page of the same color: black at 10% in light themes, white at 10% in dark.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Alias. Contrasting blocks: tooltips, inverse banners.

tokens.name: text

tokens.name: text-muted

tokens.name: text-muted-shaded

tokens.name: text-inverse

tokens.name: border

scripts.note: Noto Sans Arabic is in the sans stack. Marks above and below the letters need a taller line: 1.6 at the least.
Noto Sans Devanagari is in the sans stack. Vowel signs above the headline and below the letters need 1.5 at the least.
Noto Sans Thai is in the sans stack. Tone marks stack above vowels: 1.5 at the least (the font's own height is 1.51).
